roles.label: AI security engineer
roles.work: Build the application controls and tests around models and their tools.
roles.note: Broad security engineering, not an AI-specific salary survey.

roles.label: AI security architect
roles.work: Design data flows and decide who can authorise each action.
roles.note: Broad security architecture. Job scope and relevant experience matter more than the title.

roles.label: AI red teamer
roles.work: Test how AI systems fail and turn findings into reproducible fixes.
roles.note: Broad penetration testing and red teaming, not a premium for AI attack skills.

roles.label: AI governance and risk
roles.work: Set risk ownership and help people make informed deployment decisions.
roles.note: Broad cyber GRC. This is not a salary estimate for an AI governance lead.

roles.label: AI compliance and assurance
roles.work: Check which obligations apply and what the control evidence proves.
roles.note: Related audit and technology-risk work, not a direct AI compliance benchmark.

roles.label: AI security consultant
roles.work: Help clients scope the work, understand risks and act on findings.
roles.note: Broad security-consultant vacancies, not AI-specific consulting pay. This uses advertised salaries, not the experience-banded survey above.

roles.label: AI security researcher
roles.work: Reproduce attack and defence results, with clear test conditions.
roles.note: We have not verified a comparable UK AI-security research range. Academic pay and AI-lab total compensation should not be pooled.

roles.label: Network security
roles.work: Apply network-security experience to AI connections, egress restrictions and tool access. The learning route leads into architecture or engineering.
roles.note: UK network-security engineer vacancies, not AI-specific salaries. This describes the existing profession, not a pay rise for taking the AI route.

roles.label: Security leadership / CISO
roles.work: Set security priorities, fund controls and assign responsibility for AI risk. A CISO (chief information security officer) leads the wider security programme, not only AI.
roles.note: Broad cyber leadership, not AI-specific pay. These roles require organisational and people leadership experience; completing a learning route does not establish readiness.

source_title: Cybershark Recruitment 2026 UK Cyber Security Salary Survey
methodology: The report gives salary ranges by experience band and reports 3,861 participants overall. It does not give counts for each role/band or define how its ranges were calculated. The table is not explicitly defined as base-only. Bonuses, equity and sales OTE have not been added. These are directional recruiter benchmarks, not a representative UK market estimate or a personal salary prediction. No AI premium or currency conversion has been applied. Network security uses IT Jobs Watch advertised salary percentiles with its own observation period and sample count.
